title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
summary: From your first line of code to shipping containers through a CI/CD pipeline on a public cloud.
audience: Graduates, career switchers, IT support staff
outcomes: Use Git and work in a team repo
Explain core cloud services on Azure and AWS
Build a CI/CD pipeline and run containers
Reason about scaling, caching and reliability

stages.title: Programming foundations
stages.milestone: Write a script that reads a log file and counts errors.

stages.title: Engineering habits: Git, testing, debugging
stages.milestone: Open a pull request with a tested bug fix.

stages.title: Cloud fundamentals
stages.milestone: Sketch a 3-tier web app on Azure and on AWS and name every service.

stages.title: DevOps & delivery
stages.milestone: A pipeline that builds, tests and deploys a container on every push.

stages.title: Designing for scale
stages.milestone: Defend a design for a URL shortener in a mock interview.

title: Data Analyst
summary: Excel to SQL to Python: turn messy business data into clear answers and dashboards.
audience: Commerce, science and engineering graduates; working professionals
outcomes: Clean and analyse data in Excel with lookups and PivotTables
Explain a model's results to non-technical people

stages.title: Spreadsheet power
stages.milestone: A one-page PivotTable report on a sales dataset.

stages.title: SQL for analysis
stages.milestone: Answer ten business questions with SQL joins and GROUP BY.

stages.title: Python for data
stages.milestone: A notebook that cleans a CSV and charts monthly trends.

stages.title: Towards machine learning
stages.milestone: Present a simple forecast and its limits to a manager.
